story: Empower of Marketing was founded by Md. Iqbal Hossain, a marketer with more than six years of experience in digital and traditional marketing, and a background that spans Bangladesh and Saudi Arabia.

After working with more than fifty clients around the world, one pattern kept repeating: businesses were not failing because of one bad ad. They were stuck because marketing, sales and operations were disconnected.
So we built a different kind of partner — one that connects everything, from the first business idea to the customer who comes back again and again.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what information is handled when you visit this website or contact us, and the choices you have. We keep it simple: this website has no user accounts and does not store your data in a database.

sections.p: This website is operated by Iqbal Hossain, operating as Empower of Marketing, Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Contact: empireofmarketing4@gmail.com. We are responsible for the personal information described in this policy.

We only receive personal information you choose to send us: when you email us, message us on WhatsApp, or book a call through Calendly (for example your name, email, phone number and what you tell us about your business).

Our hosting provider may keep standard server logs (such as IP address, browser type and pages visited) for security and reliability. This website does not use analytics or advertising cookies. If you change the language, your browser may keep that preference for your session.

To reply to your messages, hold the calls you book, prepare quotes and provide services you request. Depending on your location, our legal bases are your consent, steps taken at your request before a contract, performing a contract, and our legitimate interest in running and securing the website.
We keep messages and booking details only as long as needed to answer you, provide services and meet legal or accounting obligations, then delete them.

Our service providers (such as hosting, Calendly, email and WhatsApp) may process data in other countries, including the United States. By contacting us through these services, your information is transferred to them under their safeguards.

Depending on where you live — including under the EU/UK GDPR, Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI) — you may have the right to be informed, access, correct, delete or restrict the use of your data, object to processing, withdraw consent and complain to your data protection authority. Email us to use any of these rights.
This website is for businesses and adults. We do not knowingly collect information from children.
